description: This file contains unit tests for the SubjectModified class, which is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.policies package. The tests verify immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling of SubjectModified instances.

classes.name: SubjectModifiedTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the SubjectModified class, verifying immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that SubjectModified instances and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode methods in SubjectModified.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating a SubjectModified with a null policy ID string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a SubjectModified with a null PolicyId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullLabel
methods.description: Ensures that creating a SubjectModified with a null label throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullSubject
methods.description: Ensures that creating a SubjectModified with a null subject throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toJson method returns the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests instantiating SubjectModified from valid JSON and verifies its fields.
